cohort: Women delivering in Obstetric Unit 2 who had a first-trimester record of their weight were included.
finding: The study found a strong association between maternal obesity in early pregnancy and various complications during pregnancy, delivery, and the postpartum period, with obese women showing two times higher odds compared to overweight women.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the predominant mode of delivery (55.7%) and was found to have a significant relationship with high maternal BMI.
